Section.Name: Camping Sheets
Section.Summary:
When camping, a lot of times you don't have easy access to the internet, so you can't access this site. And a book with all of the recipes can be a bit too bulky.
This section contains simplified versions that have multiple recipes condensed onto limited pages.

Pages.page:
Print this out with:
Paper Size: Legal
Orientation: Landscape
Print on Both Sides: Flip on long edge
Then fold on the lines between the columns to end up with a simple small folded flyer.
